transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Honestly, I’m here because I really struggle to just sit still or engage in any quiet activities; I find it almost impossible to keep myself calm and occupied without making a lot of noise or moving around.
Beyond the physical restlessness, do you also find that you frequently struggle to stay focused on tasks, lose important items, or have difficulty organizing your daily activities?

Yeah, I definitely have a hard time staying focused on tasks or games for very long. I honestly tend to avoid or dislike anything that requires me to put in a lot of sustained mental effort because it’s just so draining.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports significant symptoms of both hyperactivity/impulsivity (inability to sit still, needing to move) and inattentiveness (struggling to stay focused, avoiding tasks requiring sustained mental effort). Because the patient meets criteria for both clusters of symptoms, 'Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)' is now the most accurate diagnosis, replacing the broader list.
